title: Agent architecture mixed-length chat evaluation
description: A focused multi-turn chat evaluation case for testing short-question noise control, context-aware follow-up, wiki-page synthesis, source-grounded architecture design, and final document outline generation.
topic: Design an engineering Agent system from Agent Loop to production architecture, using wiki-native pages instead of chunk-style RAG evidence.

turns.question: Agent Loop 是什么？
expected_behavior: return a stable definition before expanding details
avoid dumping loosely related agent pages
treat Agent Loop as a wiki concept object rather than a keyword match

turns.question: 和 Workflow 有什么区别？
expected_behavior: inherit the Agent Loop context from the previous turn
compare control ownership, state management, tool execution, and failure recovery
avoid broad workflow retrieval that ignores the chat context

turns.question: 如果要把它做成生产级系统，需要补哪些工程模块？按执行、工具、记忆、路由和监控几个方面讲。
expected_behavior: move from concept explanation to architecture design
organize the answer by engineering modules rather than page summaries

turns.question: MCP 在这里是什么角色？
expected_behavior: resolve '这里' against the production Agent system context
explain MCP as a tool/context protocol layer rather than the Agent Loop itself
distinguish MCP from JSON-RPC, HTTP APIs, and internal tool calls

turns.question: 如果参考 OpenClaw，这个系统应该怎么设计？哪些部分可以直接借鉴，哪些需要重新设计？
expected_behavior: use OpenClaw as a reference implementation rather than the whole answer
separate mature reusable patterns from project-specific redesign needs
connect the comparison back to Agent Loop, memory, routing, tools, and monitoring

turns.question: 把前面内容整理成一份技术方案大纲，适合放进开源项目的架构设计文档。
expected_behavior: reuse prior conversation context instead of starting retrieval from scratch
produce a structured technical design outline
include project positioning, core capabilities, architecture layers, key flows, RAG comparison, OpenClaw reference, and roadmap
cite only the most relevant pages instead of listing every retrieved page
